**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep claims backed by a fresh independent citation**

When a deduplicated buyer or contractor claim has multiple citations, one aged role citation sets `stale` for the entire claim even when another citation remains within `ROLE_MAX_AGE_DAYS`; the candidate then disappears from current state and may generate a false removal event. Fresh evidence beyond the prior independent-citation repair is that age and public-source supersession are still ORed across all citations here, while the surviving-support logic only runs for `invalid_retained_supports`. Evaluate staleness per citation and retain the claim while equivalent current support remains.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/e485beea8f68934314cf4240394473c3797362db/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize equivalent need values before declaring conflict**

For admitted claims that express the same load using parser-supported variants such as `12 MW`, `12 mw`, or `12 megawatts`, this raw equality check reports `CONFLICT`; the same raw values also enter material snapshots and emit a spurious conflict transition. Canonicalize MW units and other structured field values in the domain layer before comparing them, while retaining each source's original display text and provenance.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L7](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/e485beea8f68934314cf4240394473c3797362db/AGENTS.md#L6-L7)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Lock only projects that can be affected**

Every retained-news assessment adds every project in the database to `candidate_project_ids` and then takes a row lock plus advisory lock for each one. Consequently concurrent source jobs block on the first project even when they concern unrelated records, and processing becomes O(all projects) per observation; the structured-ingestion path repeats the same global locking pattern. Discover the actual old and supported candidate IDs first, then acquire only that bounded set in UUID order.
